title: Data ownership has one canonical source
requirement: Связь component ↔ data должна иметь одно каноническое направление; components[].owns не может расходиться с data ownership, а существующие корректные записи должны сохранять читаемость.
reason: Automated by the behavioral proof; the red run below is against the previous committed store bytes.
steps: Create a record with data.ownerComponentId and assert components[].owns is derived from it.
Create a legacy record with a unique components[].owns and assert ownerComponentId is projected.
Submit conflicting canonical and legacy ownership; submit two legacy owners for one data item; assert invalid_record with ownership_conflict/ownership_ambiguous.
Read the existing ambiguous canonical record and assert it remains readable and byte-faithful.
expected: data.ownerComponentId is the only canonical system owner; components[].owns is a derived/legacy projection; a unique legacy owner migrates, conflicts are refused, and an older ambiguous record stays readable but cannot be written.
